plugin.name: Knight Rider PCSX2F Fusion Fix
ForceAspectRatio.description: Auto follows the emulator display. Override with a width:height ratio or decimal; set the emulator display to the same ratio. Changes apply during play.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the driving camera's field of view; 1.0 is the original framing. Mission start scenes keep their own framing. Changes apply during play.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places the side HUD panels at the screen edges. A ratio keeps them at the edges of a centered box of that shape. The cockpit view always keeps its HUD on the 4:3 dashboard. Changes apply during play.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original shows the videos as the game does, a 4:3 picture with black bars. Fill shows the whole widescreen picture as large as the screen allows. Changes apply during play.
CutsceneBorders.description: Black bars for the scenes at the start of a mission. Letterbox keeps the original bars above and below, Pillarbox keeps the original 4:3 framing with bars at the sides, Both combines them, Off fills the screen. Changes apply during play.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the Davilex logo and the opening video at startup. Restart the game to apply.
